description: I maintained and developed their responsive web application using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, and HTML. I consistently improved and added features to their content management system (CMS) with a focus on making it user-friendly for non-technical colleagues, enhancing their daily workflows. Additionally, I built and launched their TV application for premium users on both Apple and Android platforms using React Native. I also implemented various features from Stripe to handle customer management, subscriptions, and card payments.

I was responsible for a carpet warehouse and led a team of two people. My responsibilities included managing inventory and ensuring that our products were always ready for upcoming events and deliveries.
